text:
Alex: Quick async standup — what I did / blockers / today. Did: finished the prewarm script tweaks for us-west1, ran a 2h soak on nodepool-b. Blocker: seeing intermittent stalls during KV cache warm that look like OOM kills on single pods. Today: want to isolate the pattern + open quota request if we need more reserved GPUs.

Priya: thx. Can you paste the crash log snippet? also which instance type?

Alex: snippet below — looks like oom when batch size spikes after a few prefix requests:
```
[2026-03-17T10:12:07Z] pod/worker-23 OOMKilled memory: 30.1Gi used, limit 32Gi
model: redwood-v2-7b, seq_len=1024, batch=12
```
instances: G5-16x (us-west1-a) for this pool.

Chen: fyi we've had 3 spot evictions in us-west1 this morning, might be related to noisy neighbors. Evictions: 10:05, 10:22, 10:36.

Sam: @Alex did you try disabling async prefetch in the runtime? sometimes that reduces concurrent mem spikes.

Alex: not yet, plan to A/B that. also thinking about lowering default batch size to 8 for that pool as a quick mitigation.

Priya: if we reduce batch, perf drops but avoids OOMs — acceptable short term. for quota: what's the ask? how many GPUs to request and which regions?

Alex: request +4 G5-16x reserved in us-west1 and +2 in us-central1 for buffer. That should cover expected peak and evictions. Will draft a quota request doc.

Chen: suggest also increasing prewarm headroom to 20% for that pool so autoscaler keeps a few spare nodes. current headroom is 8%.

Alex: noted. I'll update autoscaling policy and run a canary with headroom=20%.

provision-bot: deployment:prewarm-headroom-update requested by Alex. Change: nodepool-b headroom 8% -> 20%. ETA: 15m to roll.

Sam: quick ask — @Priya can you review the quota justification once Alex drafts it? you're on call for cloud requests.

Priya: sure, ping me when it's in docs. Also add cost estimate (monthly) and fallback plan if quota denied: route to ded framework + reduced batch and extra prefix caching.

Alex: will do. Leaving this as action items: 1) run A/B with async prefetch off; 2) lower batch size to 8 on nodepool-b canary; 3) open quota request +4(us-west1)+2(us-central1) with cost and fallback; 4) increase headroom to 20% (in progress).

Chen: tagging infra FYI: we should also check kernel version differences across AZs — had once where mixed kernels caused OOM-like behavior under high mem pressure.

Sam: gh pr for the prewarm script change? cc: me for quick CR.

Alex: pushing PR now: https://github.com/redwood-inference/infra/pull/742 (short description in PR).

Priya: thanks — keep updates here. :thumbsup:
